notes.title: Update 1.2.1 News (Patch Notes + Mac and Linux Bugs)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Firstly, we want to apologize for the sparse notes regarding releases lately. We have a big announcement coming soon!

Second, it recently came to our attention that the game was "available" on Mac and Linux. We would like to clarify that this is false. It was an issue in the backend of Steam. The bug has since been patched along with some others.

Please remember to stay tuned for a huge announcement coming up!

Thank you,
The Raccoon


Patch Notes:

 Fixed a bug that forced saves to save via XML (unreported)
 Fixed 24c4 - Corporation Bug
 Fixed 59a1 - Linux + Mac Display Bug
 Fixed 18k1, 32t1, 92b2 - All Related to Save Games
 Fixed 24c2 - Trade Bug

notes.title: Update: v1.2 released, changes to manual
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is live.

Fixes:
Monopolization allowing double-sale of goods
Flexible convoy not refunding spent fleet on undo
Champion no longer missing in action during combat

Manual has been updated slightly, and re-homed to permanent URL.  

We're working on v1.3 now :-)

notes.title: Release TODAY!
notes.notes: We finished one more patch late yesterday, and the 2nd version of the manual is almost complete.  Tutorial video is going to be made and linked here as well.  We don't want anyone confused by the unique play-style of our game, so we're doing everything possible to clarify how to play.  Note: There are tooltips in-game but there's no tutorial  READ THE MANUAL!  In fact, I encourage you to read the manual BEFORE you purchase the game.  This is not a MOO clone, and there's nothing else on the market like it - so take a look at the video and the manual so you know what to expect.
